Mesh Msg

group GENERIC_LOCATION_MESH_MSG

Definitions and structures for mesh message types used by the models.

Defines

GENERIC_LOCATION_GLOBAL_LATITUDE_NOT_CONFIGURED 0x80000000

Indicates latitude is not configured.

GENERIC_LOCATION_GLOBAL_LONGITUDE_NOT_CONFIGURED 0x80000000

Indicates longitude is not configured.

GENERIC_LOCATION_ALTITUDE_NOT_CONFIGURED 0x7FFF

Indicates altitude is not configured.

GENERIC_LOCATION_ALTITUDE_UPPER_LIMIT 0x7FFE

Indicates altitude is greater than or equal to 32766 meters/decimeters.

GENERIC_LOCATION_LOCAL_NORTH_NOT_CONFIGURED 0x8000

Indicates local north value is not configured.

GENERIC_LOCATION_LOCAL_EAST_NOT_CONFIGURED 0x8000

Indicates local east value is not configured.

GENERIC_LOCATION_FLOOR_NUM_LOWER_LIMIT 0x00

Represents floor -20 or any floor below -20.

GENERIC_LOCATION_FLOOR_NUM_UPPER_LIMIT 0xFC

Represents floor 232 or any floor above 232.

GENERIC_LOCATION_FLOOR_NUM_GROUND_FLOOR0 0xFD

Represents ground floor, floor 0.

GENERIC_LOCATION_FLOOR_NUM_GROUND_FLOOR1 0xFE

Represents ground floor, floor 1.

GENERIC_LOCATION_FLOOR_NUM_NOT_CONFIGURED 0xFF

Indicates floor number is not configured.
